reason: The ingredient list is exactly what I look for, I'll give it that. But 55 crowns a can on a driver's wage, and ordering from a separate e-shop when I already get everything from Rohlík, is too much for something I'd want to drink every shift.
objection: 55 CZK for 80 mg of caffeine. That's less than my usual can and costs more than double. I'm not sure I'd even feel it on a night shift.
would_change_my_mind: If it were in Rohlík's bio section for around 35 CZK, so I could add a few cans to my weekly order and try it without paying extra for delivery.
